description_en: Refreshes instances in a scaling group when you need to apply a new scaling configuration or update the image of instances in the scaling group
description_zh: 在您需要将新的伸缩配置应用到伸缩组实例中时，或需要更新伸缩组中实例的镜像时，您可以调用本接口完成伸缩组中实例的刷新
kebab_example: aliyun ess start-instance-refresh --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartInstanceRefresh

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The minimum percentage of instances that must remain in service in the scaling group during the instance refresh. Valid values: 0 to 100.
Default value: 80
parameters.help_zh:
实例刷新期间，保持伸缩组中正常提供服务占伸缩组容量的比例。取值范围 0～100。
默认值：80
parameters.name: min_healthy_percentage

parameters.help_en:
The maximum percentage by which the number of instances in the scaling group can exceed the scaling group capacity during the instance refresh. Valid values: 100 to 200.
Default value: 120.

When MinHealthyPercentage = MaxHealthyPercentage = 100, one instance is refreshed at a time
parameters.help_zh:
实例刷新期间，伸缩组中实例可以超出伸缩组容量的比例。取值范围 100～200。
默认值：120。

当MinHealthyPercentage = MaxHealthyPercentage = 100时，每次会刷新1个实例
parameters.name: max_healthy_percentage

fields.help_en: The arguments for the container startup command. A maximum of 10 arguments are supported
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数。最多 10 个
fields.name: args

fields.help_en: The container startup commands. A maximum of 20 commands are supported. Each command can contain up to 256 characters
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令。最多 20 个。每个命令最多包含 256 个字符
fields.name: commands

fields.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
fields.name: field_ref_field_path

fields.help_en: The name of the environment variable. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, and underscores (_). It cannot start with a digit
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名。长度为 1~128 位。格式要求：[0-9a-zA-Z]，以及下划线，不能以数字开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable. The value can be 0 to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 环境变量值。长度为 0~256 位
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The list of containers in the instance.

This parameter is supported only for Elastic Container Instance (ECI) scaling groups.
Only container configurations whose names match `Container.Name` in the current scaling configuration container list are refreshed
fields.help_zh:
实例包含的容器列表。

该参数仅支持ECI类型伸缩组。
只会刷新当前伸缩配置容器列表中和`Container.Name`相同的容器配置
fields.name: containers

fields.help_en:
The image ID.



After the instance refresh task is completed, the image in the currently active configuration of the scaling group is updated to this image.
This parameter is not supported when the instance configuration source of the scaling group is a launch template.
Images that contain data cloud disks are not supported
fields.help_zh:
镜像ID。



实例刷新任务执行成功后，伸缩组当前生效的配置信息中的镜像配置会更新为该镜像。
伸缩组当前生效的配置信息来源是启动模版时不支持设置该参数。
目前不支持设置带有数据盘的镜像
fields.name: image_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the launch template. This parameter specifies that the scaling group obtains launch configuration information from the launch template
fields.help_zh: 实例启动模板的 ID，用于指定伸缩组从实例启动模板获取启动配置信息
fields.name: launch_template_id

fields.help_en:
The instance type that overrides the instance type specified in the launch template.

This parameter takes effect only when the LaunchTemplateId parameter specifies a launch template
fields.help_zh:
本参数用于指定实例规格，会覆盖启动模板中的实例规格。

仅当LaunchTemplateId参数指定了启动模板时，本参数生效
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en: The instance type information that extends the launch template
fields.help_zh: 扩展启动模板的实例规格信息
fields.name: launch_template_overrides

fields.help_en:
The version of the launch template. Valid values:

A fixed template version number.
Default: always uses the default version of the template.
Latest: always uses the latest version of the template.

Rollback is not supported for instance refresh tasks when the version is set to Default or Latest
fields.help_zh:
实例启动模板的版本。取值范围：

固定的模板版本号。
Default：始终使用模板默认版本。
Latest：始终使用模板最新版本。

版本设置为 Default、Latest 时，实例刷新任务不支持回滚
fields.name: launch_template_version

fields.help_en: The ID of the scaling configuration
fields.name: scaling_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The desired configuration for the instance refresh.

You cannot specify ScalingConfigurationId, ImageId, LaunchTemplateId, and Containers at the same time. If this parameter is left empty, the currently active configuration of the scaling group is used for the refresh.
After the instance refresh task is completed, the active scaling configuration of the scaling group is updated to this configuration
parameters.help_zh:
实例刷新的期望配置。

ScalingConfigurationId 、ImageId、LaunchTemplateId、Containers 不可以同时设置。当该参数为空时，以伸缩组当前生效的配置进行刷新。
实例刷新任务执行成功后，伸缩组生效的伸缩配置会更新为该配置
parameters.name: desired_configuration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip instances that match the desired configuration.

The system determines whether an instance matches based on the ID of the desired scaling configuration, not by comparing individual configuration items.

Valid values:

true: Instances that were already created with the desired configuration are skipped.
false: All instances in the scaling group at the time the refresh task starts are refreshed.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否跳过和期望配置匹配的实例。

系统会根据期望伸缩配置的ID界定是否匹配，不会对比具体的配置项。

取值范围：

true：跳过。当启动实例刷新任务时，系统会检查每个实例的配置。对于已经使用期望配置创建的实例，不执行刷新操作。
false：不跳过。在启动实例刷新任务后，刷新任务启动时所有伸缩组中的实例。

默认值：true
parameters.name: skip_matching

fields.help_en:
The percentage of new instances to total instances in the scaling group at which the task is automatically paused. Valid values: 1 to 100 (%).

The values must be specified in ascending order, and the last percentage value must be 100
fields.help_zh:
伸缩组中新实例占总实例的占比，到达该占比时任务自动暂停。取值范围：1 ～100 （%）。

需要从小到大设置，且最后一个进度百分比需要为100
fields.name: percentage

parameters.help_en: The checkpoints for the refresh task. Specifies that the task is automatically paused for CheckpointPauseTime minutes when the percentage of new instances reaches the specified value during the instance refresh
parameters.help_zh: 刷新任务检查点：指定在实例刷新过程中，当新实例占比达到设定值时自动暂停任务CheckpointPauseTime分钟
parameters.name: checkpoints

parameters.help_en:
The duration for which the task is paused when a checkpoint is reached.
Unit: minutes.
Valid values: 1 to 2880.
Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
当进入刷新任务检查点时，暂停的时长。
单位：分钟
取值范围 : 1～ 2880
默认值：60
parameters.name: checkpoint_pause_time

parameters.help_en:
The execution strategy for the instance refresh task. Valid values:

Rolling: The instance refresh task creates new instances and releases old instances to refresh instances.

ReplaceSystemDisk: The system cloud disk of existing instances is replaced by specifying DesiredConfiguration.image to update the system cloud disk.

Default value: Rolling
parameters.help_zh:
实例刷新任务的运行策略，取值范围：

Rolling：实例刷新任务通过创建新实例，释放旧实例的方式进行实例刷新。

ReplaceSystemDisk：在原有实例基础上更新系统盘，通过指定DesiredConfiguration.image 更新实例系统盘。

默认值：Rolling
parameters.name: strategy

InstanceRefreshTaskId.description_en: The ID of the instance refresh task
